reason: This is the only offered combination, and it should connect the intestinal blood route to the liver.

reaction: Seeing the whole route together made the purpose of the thin lining and nearby vessels clearer.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the vein was most worthwhile because the result showed the complete path from the gut lining into the blood and toward the liver.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding capillaries was a clear but fairly predictable intermediate step; its result mostly set up the final connection.

surprise.text: The comparison showing how much surface fits into the folds made the value of the villi clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: each connection matched a stated goal or an outlined part of the route.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see what happens to the absorbed nutrients, though the compatible-option menu made this chapter's choices fairly predictable.
